sources.entry: deepinfer - DeepSeek's production inference engine for DeepSeek models, with MoE expert parallelism.

summary.one_liner: DeepInfer is DeepSeek's open-source offline inference framework for DeepSeek models, with MoE expert parallelism and speculative-decoding features, targeting NVIDIA SM100 and Huawei Ascend 950 hardware.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes an inference engine that runs offline inference on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, downloaded from Hugging Face or loaded from a local directory. It lists parallelism support (attention data parallel, balanced context parallel, MoE expert parallel with EPLB), a draft-token decoding mode (DSpark) with confidence-scheduled verification, and bounded suffix replay for decoder prefill. It also covers asynchronous batch scheduling, batch-invariant and deterministic sampling, and structured outputs constrained by regex, JSON schema, or EBNF grammar. Kernels named include FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, DeepSelect, and custom TileLang kernels. The README states that a KV cache system and prefill/decode disaggregation are not included in this release.
use_cases: offline batch inference with DeepSeek models
running DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on NVIDIA SM100 GPUs
running DeepSeek models on Huawei Ascend NPUs
constraining model output to JSON schema or grammar
how_to_run: Create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment
Optionally set DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 to use a local checkpoint
notable: Supports only DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as a listed model
Speculative-style DSpark decoding with configurable max draft length via environment variables
Batch-invariant and deterministic sampling modes (NVIDIA only)
Bounded SWA suffix replay to reduce decoder prefill work
Asynchronous zero-overhead batch scheduler enabled by default
caveats: The open-source release is offline inference only; KV cache, prefill/decode disaggregation, and cross-replica load balancing are not included
Requires Linux, GCC >= 13, Python 3.12, and CUDA 13 or CANN 9.2 with specific hardware (SM100 GPUs or Ascend 950 NPUs)
Batch-invariant and deterministic sampling are NVIDIA only
